project.name: Redesk 核心页面
project.designRead: Personal book library management / avid readers / warm editorial calm / medium density / avoid neon tech feel

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Claude DL terra-cotta accent #C96442, paper-like backgrounds, warm gray text, muted beige surfaces
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Soft geometry: 8px/12px/16px/20px/24px radius, quiet paper-like shadows
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Newsreader for display, Poppins for compact UI, Lora for reading surfaces, Geist Mono for code
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Lightweight controls, tonal separation over nested borders, editorial warmth
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Quiet elevation for separation, not spectacle; tonal surface layering
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Clean SVG icons via CSS mask, editorial product photography style
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Calm, readable, trustworthy; subtle hover transitions

iconAssets.coloringRule: currentColor by default; override with Library token when needed

pages.title: 书架
pages.visualNorthStar: Open, breathable book grid with editorial warmth — each book card feels like a bookshelf entry, not a data row

continuityAnchors.header: Left sidebar with nav: 书架(active), 阅读档案, plus bottom settings area
continuityAnchors.surfaceModel: Paper-like bg, warm beige cards, terra-cotta accent for active states
continuityAnchors.typography: Newsreader for section headings, Poppins for labels and controls, Lora for book descriptions

pages.soulElement: Book covers displayed with subtle warm shadow and gentle hover lift — like pulling a book from a real shelf
pages.requirements: 书架主页：搜索栏、筛选器组（状态/分类/标签/可见性）、概览统计卡片（总数/各状态数量/最近新增/最近阅读/今日推荐）、书籍网格（封面/书名/作者/状态标签/评分/阅读进度/上次读到第几页）、批量操作栏、空状态引导、新建书籍按钮

pages.title: 书籍详情
pages.visualNorthStar: A single-book information hub that reads like a well-organized reading journal page — warm, clear, layered

continuityAnchors.header: Left sidebar with nav: 书架, 阅读档案, plus bottom settings area
continuityAnchors.surfaceModel: Paper-like bg, warm beige cards, terra-cotta accent for active states
continuityAnchors.typography: Newsreader for book title, Poppins for labels, Lora for reading notes content

pages.soulElement: Book cover with warm glow shadow alongside metadata — the page feels like opening a personal reading journal
pages.requirements: 书籍详情页：封面大图+书名+作者+出版社+ISBN+简介、状态标签可切换、评分可编辑、标签增删、分类、可见性开关、阅读目的标记、操作按钮组（编辑/阅读/删除）、文件管理区（文件列表/上传/主文件标记/下载/替换/删除）、阅读痕迹区（进度/高亮列表/笔记列表/全文搜索）、关联主题列表、状态变更历史时间轴、AI 派生内容区（视觉区分）

pages.title: 阅读档案
pages.visualNorthStar: A personal reading dashboard that feels like a warm annual reading report — numbers tell a quiet story

continuityAnchors.header: Left sidebar with nav: 书架, 阅读档案(active), plus bottom settings area
continuityAnchors.surfaceModel: Paper-like bg, warm beige cards, terra-cotta accent for active states
continuityAnchors.typography: Newsreader for section headings, Poppins for stat numbers and labels, Lora for activity descriptions

pages.soulElement: Reading streak heatmap using warm terra-cotta intensity gradient — like ink absorption on paper
pages.requirements: 阅读档案页：顶部统计卡片（累计书籍数/高亮数/笔记数/连续阅读天数/年度目标进度环）、阅读活跃度区（热力图/趋势折线图/阅读时长统计）、书架结构区（各状态数量分布/已读未读比例饼图/类别分布柱状图/想要vs实际对比）、最近动态区（最近新增/最近阅读/最近笔记）、阅读历史列表
